title: International Higher Diploma in Business Administration (Level 4 and 5)
description: The purpose of the International Higher Diploma in Business Administration (Level 4&5) is to develop students professionally and individually self-reflecting who are able to satisfy the demands of the business sector and work in a constantly changing world.
longDescription: The purpose of the International Higher Diploma in Business Administration (Level 4&5) is to develop students professionally and individually self-reflecting who are able to satisfy the demands of the business sector and work in a constantly changing world around them. This course develops your ability to understand business issues, analyze management problems and find workable solutions. The course introduces you to the fundamental concepts that are essential to understanding how businesses function so that if you either opt for higher education or join a business, you will stand out with your critically developed understanding of the key skills needed to thrive in the business world. This International Higher Diploma in Business Administration (Level 4& 5) serves as a basis of your further business education and attracting employment opportunities. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 240 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: 13 source-listed curriculum sections and 24 lesson or resource entries are included below.
entry: For entry into Level 4 & 5 International Higher Diploma in Business Administration, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from Girne American University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive a degree from GSS Partner Universities.
Complete several modules ranging from Business Leadership and Managing People.
Obtain a degree without necessarily leaving your country.
advantages: Blended delivery is recorded on the official programme page.

modules.title: ASSIGNMENT & STUDY GUIDELINES
modules.summary: This module provides the most critical information about the study course and assignment submission.

lessons.title: Summarising, Paraphrasing, Quotation for your Assignment

modules.title: LEVEL 4 - INTRODUCTION TO BUSINESS RESEARCH
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to enable learners to develop effective research plans, evaluate different research methods, use a high standard of academic writing, and use independent learning techniques to support their research capabilities.

modules.title: LEVEL 4 - EXTERNAL STRUCTURE AND NATURE OF BUSINESS
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of the dimensions of the business environment, including various business types and purposes and to be able to identify and analyze different external stakeholders. This Unit will develop a learner’s understanding of the PESTEL environment and other forces influencing business decisions.

modules.title: LEVEL 4 - BUSINESS INFORMATION REPORTING
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to enhance learners’ business communication and reporting skills and enable them to operate confidently in the business world. The learner will be able to identify the reporting channels, types of communication tools, and reporting structures to manage the information flow in an organization.

modules.title: LEVEL 4 - INTERNAL STRUCTURE AND NATURE OF BUSINESS
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of businesses types and structures. The learner will be able to identify the flow of business operations, functional departments and roles within a business environment.

modules.title: LEVEL 4 - INTRODUCTION TO FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of the current regulations governing financial reporting, as well as the purpose and formats of financial statements for different users.The learner will be able to learn to interpret and create different financial statements.

modules.title: LEVEL 4 - INTRODUCTION TO STATISTICS AND FORECASTING
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to review the basic concepts in calculus, algebraic equations, graph construction, statistics and probability that need to be understood by all business learners. The emphasis rests on applying these concepts to a variety of mathematical and scheduling problems encountered in business contexts.

modules.title: LEVEL 5 - INTRODUCTION TO BUSINESS AND COMMERCIAL LAW
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of the concepts and principles of UK business law and the ability to apply them to practical situations.

modules.title: LEVEL 5 - MANAGING BUSINESS PROJECTS
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding and skills relating to the project management principles, methodologies, tools and techniques that are used in business.

modules.title: LEVEL 5 - MANAGING PEOPLE IN BUSINESS
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to introduce learners to Human Resource theory and skills that underpin Human Resource Management (HRM) practices through a range of case studies. The unit will enable the learner to successfully manage people and talent in an organization.

modules.title: LEVEL 5 - PRINCIPLES OF MARKETING
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to provide learners with a detailed understanding of the marketing planning process and to apply these principles to a variety of business contexts. The unit also provides a comprehensive understanding of environmental analysis and how this can lead to the development of appropriate objectives and strategies to enhance operational marketing performance.

modules.title: LEVEL 5 - PRINCIPLES OF FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ skills in preparing financial statements for a variety of organisations using a range of techniques, and that comply with legal and regulatory requirements.

modules.title: LEVEL 5 - CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY AND ETHICS
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to provide learners with a broad understanding of the roles and requirements for businesses to embed ethics and incorporate social responsibility. It provides learners with an understanding of the issues surrounding corporate social responsibility and ethics from national and international perspectives. Significant emphasis is placed on the role that corporate governance plays in ensuring accountability to the owners and other stakeholders within businesses.

lessons.title: Foundation of Business Ethics and Corporate Governance
Corporate Social Responsibility and Stakeholders’ Ethics
